name: Quality Metrics
purpose: Gives specific, detailed measurements of a project or product attribute and how to measure it to verify compliance. The manage quality process consults the metrics to make sure the processes used will meet them; in control quality, deliverables or processes are measured and compared with the metric to decide whether the result is acceptable or corrective action or rework is needed.

tailoring: On smaller projects quality metrics, requirements and specifications are considered the same thing; some industries say 'specifications' instead of 'metrics'.
Many industries have standards that include metrics; these must be followed. The quality management plan may cite the regulations or have them built into organizational policies and procedures.
